releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* fix(customLitematicaBlockReplace): 修复替换列表项缺少分隔符时数组越界 by @Linecos in https://github.com/jfglzs/Antideath-survival-assistant/pull/41
* fix(customBlockCollision): 修复黑名单开关与白名单配置项重名 by @Linecos in https://github.com/jfglzs/Antideath-survival-assistant/pull/40
* fix(configs): 修复自动清理模式配置项未翻译 by @Linecos in https://github.com/jfglzs/Antideath-survival-assistant/pull/39
* fix(autovault): 修复命令树被破坏导致 start/stop 不可用 by @Linecos in https://github.com/jfglzs/Antideath-survival-assistant/pull/37
* 将异步客户端光照更新功能 改为 禁用客户端光照更新

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jfglzs/Antideath-survival-assistant/compare/1.7.5...1.7.6

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* fix(forceUseFireWork): 修复打开强制使用烟花时烟花被使用两次 by @Linecos in https://github.com/jfglzs/Antideath-survival-assistant/pull/34
* fix(optItemFrame): 修复打开展示框优化后地图画面消失 by @Linecos in https://github.com/jfglzs/Antideath-survival-assistant/pull/33
* fix(tabFilter): 修复前缀过滤判定错误 by @Linecos in https://github.com/jfglzs/Antideath-survival-assistant/pull/32
* fix(autoWasteClean): 修复潜影盒被整盒丢出 by @Linecos in https://github.com/jfglzs/Antideath-survival-assistant/pull/31
* fix: 修复创造模式丢物品失效 by @Linecos in https://github.com/jfglzs/Antideath-survival-assistant/pull/30
* fix: 修复未安装可选前置模组使用部分功能时游戏崩溃 by @Linecos in https://github.com/jfglzs/Antideath-survival-assistant/pull/29


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jfglzs/Antideath-survival-assistant/compare/1.7.4...1.7.5
